import trimesh, numpy as np, glob
print(glob.glob('checks/assembly/*.stl'))
a=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.f07e2875.stl')
b=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.07b3764e.stl')
# sample points on b, query a
pts,_=trimesh.sample.sample_surface(b,200000)
from trimesh.proximity import closest_point
cp,dist,tri=closest_point(a,pts)
i=np.argmin(dist)
print('min sampled',dist[i],pts[i],cp[i])
order=np.argsort(dist)[:10]
for j in order: print(round(float(dist[j]),3),pts[j],cp[j])
